transcript: Hi, my internet has been cutting out every night around 8pm. It's really hurting my remote work.
The latest firmware update bricked my router. Now none of the lights turn on and I can't connect.
Billing keeps charging me for premium support even though I cancelled last month. Please fix this.
I love the new mobile app but the notifications arrive hours late and sometimes never.
Support was kind but they keep sending scripted responses without solving my login lockout.
